notes: Two taḥwīl routes; the names after the last ح («عن إبراهيم، عن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد، عن سلمان») are written once and belong to both groups.
«الأعمش» is one man standing in both routes (occurrence 1 in the first, occurrence 2 as co-transmitter with منصور in the second).
«قال أجل أمرنا» is Salman's own words: the chain ends at Salman; the Prophet is not named.
